messages.text:
Hi HeliumDeploy Team,

I hope you’re doing well!

My name is Archana K., and I represent Baagul LLP. We manage multiple
coupon and affiliate websites, including *Manually Reviewed* (
https://manuallyreviewed.com/), where we publish SEO-focused reviews,
product comparisons, and dedicated deal pages.

We’re interested in promoting HeliumDeploy through our website and would
like to request a *custom promo code* for our audience, along with an
affiliate tracking link.

Could you please let me know if you can offer:

   -

   An exclusive promo code with a special discount for our audience.
   -

   An affiliate link with commission tracking.
   -

   Details about commission rates, cookie duration, and payout terms.
   -

   Any promotional materials to support our campaigns.

An exclusive discount code would help us create dedicated promotional
content and encourage more users to try HeliumDeploy.

Thank you for your time. I look forward to hearing from you!

Thanks and Regards..!
*Archana K.*
Handed to the team · Affiliate/partnership terms are not mine to set or quote.

Hi Archana,

Thanks for reaching out, and for the interest in HeliumDeploy.

Affiliate partnerships, commission rates, cookie duration and payout terms aren't something I can set or quote. I've passed your request to Abel and Georges, who handle partnerships here. The team is offline right now and picks this up today at 10am Eastern, and they'll reply to you on this thread with what they can offer on the code, the tracking link and the promotional assets.

Nothing more is needed from your side in the meantime.

Best regards,
Sarah, HeliumDeploy

Hi Sarah,

Thank you for the update!

I’ve already received my affiliate tracking link. I’m only looking for
a *custom
promo code* for my audience to use when purchasing HeliumDeploy services.

Could you please ask the partnerships team if they can provide an exclusive
discount code for our website, Manually Reviewed?

Thanks and Regards..!
*Archana K.*

Hi Archana,

Thanks for clarifying, that helps.

A public promo code tied to a partner site isn't one I can create. Our codes are issued per customer on their own order, so a code meant for your audience has to come from Abel or Georges, who set the discount and the terms that go with it.

That request is already with them, and I've made the narrower ask clear: a single exclusive code for Manually Reviewed, alongside the tracking link you already have. They pick it up today at 10am Eastern and will reply here with the code and the terms.

Best regards,
Sarah, HeliumDeploy

Hi Sarah,

Thank you for clarifying and for forwarding my request to Abel and Georges.

I appreciate your help in making the request clear. I’ll wait for their
response regarding the exclusive promo code for Manually Reviewed.

Thanks and Regards..!
*Archana K.*

Hi Archana,

Sounds good. It's with Abel and Georges, and they'll reply on this thread once they've looked at it today.

Thanks for your patience, and for thinking of us for Manually Reviewed.

Best regards,
Sarah, HeliumDeploy
